fit.selection_mode: null plus paired one-SE held-out prediction; optional iid-noise evidence; all-row refit
fit.criterion: Numerical NNLS residual proxy; independent iid sigma required for the separate model check.
fit.preprocessing: Signed observations; restored RMS scale per training split; no minimum subtraction, clipping, column normalization or penalties.
fit.noise_assumption: Independent zero-mean Gaussian errors with a known common sigma in every observed cell.
fit.diagnostic_scope: Predictive shared rank and numerical checks; neither chemical species count nor physical validation.
